about.title: About the brand
about.body: ＹＡＮÈＬＬＥ was founded with quiet intention — for form, material, and the space between them. We create mid-luxury women's clothing and accessories without excess gesture, with respect for silhouette and time. The founder shaped this language as a capsule of calm: less noise, more clarity. Each piece passes through the atelier, where proportion, touch of cloth, and longevity matter.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: These Terms of use govern access to the ＹＡＮÈＬＬＥ website, placing orders, and interacting with our service.

sections.title: General
sections.body: By using the site you confirm that you have read and accept these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the site.

sections.title: Orders and payment
sections.body:
Orders are placed through the shopping bag. Primary delivery is Nova Poshta. Payment may be cash on delivery or online when the gateway is connected.

We may contact you to confirm an order. ＹＡＮÈＬＬＥ may decline an order in case of pricing error, stock issues, or suspected fraud.

sections.title: Shipping and returns
sections.body: Shipping and return conditions are described on the Shipping page. Returns are accepted within 14 days if tags, packaging, and condition are preserved. Card payments may require an unboxing video.

sections.title: Intellectual property
sections.body: All site materials (text, imagery, design, logo) belong to ＹＡＮÈＬＬＥ or are used under license. Copying without written consent is prohibited.

sections.title: Contact
sections.body: For questions about these terms: hello@yanelle.com

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We respect your privacy and process personal data only to fulfil orders and improve the service.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: Name, phone, email, city, Nova Poshta branch / address, order contents, and technical data (cookies, device type, interface language) as needed to run the site.

sections.title: How we use data
sections.body: To process and deliver orders, contact you, provide support, analyse traffic when enabled, and meet legal requirements.

sections.title: Sharing with third parties
sections.body: Data may be shared with the carrier (Nova Poshta) and payment providers only as needed to fulfil the order. We do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You may request access, correction, or deletion of your data at hello@yanelle.com. Some data is retained as required for order records and law.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: ＹＡＮÈＬＬＥ uses cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences and keep the service working correctly.

sections.title: What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small files stored in your browser. They help remember language, currency, bag contents, and other session settings.

sections.title: Cookies we use
sections.body:
Essential — bag, checkout, and basic preferences.
Functional — language, currency, wishlist.
Analytics — when enabled, to understand how the site is used (without selling data).

sections.title: Managing cookies
sections.body: You can limit or delete cookies in your browser settings. Disabling essential cookies may affect the bag and checkout.
